prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a SINGLE STATIC horizontal comic strip for a website loading card. Wide landscape canvas, ideally 2048 x 512, four equally sized vignettes IN ONE ROW, with consistent generous outer margin and small clean gutters. The SAME endearing beaver mascot appears in all four panels: unmistakable beaver with a broad flat crosshatched paddle tail, two large front incisors, rounded small ears, short muzzle, compact body. Friendly and absorbed in its work, not frantic. Panel 1: the beaver connects two clearly visible cable plugs with its paws, a simple little network of cables on a small workbench. Panel 2: the beaver knits a small piece of fabric with two needles and a yarn ball. Panel 3: the beaver sits reading an open instruction manual whose pages have only tiny abstract diagrams, no letters. Panel 4: the beaver takes a snack break, holding and nibbling a small biscuit. Keep the same face, proportions and character identity across all four scenes. Minimalist retro game-console pixel art, sophisticated polished one-bit sprite design, thick clean silhouettes, readable small props and expressive poses. STRICTLY TWO SOLID COLORS: pure black #000000 and pure white #ffffff. Solid opaque white background everywhere, no transparency. NO grays, no gradients, no dithering, no antialiasing, no shadows, no glows, no soft textures, no faux screen noise. Crisp square pixel steps and simple lines, logical pixel grid, clean negative space, no overly tiny details. A discreet pixel-corner frame around each vignette, never heavy. The four scenes must be immediately readable when displayed as a 560-pixel-wide strip. No captions, no text, no typography, no logos, no extra panels. This is a static four-scene comic, NOT an animation sprite sheet and NOT four phases of one action.
